newsitem.title: UK: RMC drops on press comment after results.
newsitem.headline: RMC drops on press comment after results.

text.p: Shares in RMC Group Plc dropped on Friday after cautious press coverage of Thursday's results, analysts said.
The building materials group was trading 15p lower at 981-1/2 by 1250 GMT, above its lows in January but well off a peak of 11.95-1/2 stg reached in September last year.

"The shares shot up initially on the results because people just looked at the headline figure, but they soon reassessed, and coupled with today's unenthusiastic press reports the shares have suffered," one analyst said.

The Financial Times newspaper's 'Lex' column said the outlook for the company was "hardly rosy", largely due to a continued decline in volumes forecast for Germany, one of its biggest markets. The paper said the strength of sterling was also having an adverse effect.

RMC on Thursday reported a fall in pre-tax profits to 295.3 million stg from 324.9 million and announced a change in its accounting policy to allow for exchange rate volatility. Based on the previous system profits would have been at the top end of expectations.
Analysts said a cautious trading statement from RMC on Thursday had also unsettled investor confidence.
"RMC said they expected results to be down again next year and that probably jolted a few people -- it was a harsh dose of reality which dented the price," an analyst said.
